tools.name: market_overview

The whole market in one reading: how many perps lean bullish vs bearish on
liquidation pressure, and the markets leaning hardest each way.

The score compares short-liquidation exposure ABOVE price (forced buys if price
rises) with long-liquidation exposure BELOW it (forced sells if it falls),
weigh

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description:
Market symbols LiqFlow covers, to resolve a name ("solana") to its market
symbol (SOL). `scored` markets also have scores, funding, depth and
volume; the rest have node data only (positions, levels, liquidations). Uses 2
API calls.

tools.name: open_interest_ranking
tools.description:
Hyperliquid markets ranked by open interest (USD), with how many positions
are open in each, from every wallet on the node.

tools.name: coin_snapshot
tools.description:
Everything about one market right now: live price and 24h change, its
liquidation-pressure score, liquidation exposure each side and how close it
sits, the nearest big cluster, its rank among all markets, and what changed
since the previous snapshot. Start here for any question about one coin. Uses

tools.name: liquidation_map
tools.description:
Where the forced orders sit around the current price for one market, from
every wallet on the node: liquidation prices (longs below = forced sells,
shorts above = forced buys), resting stop-loss / take-profit trigger orders,
and order-book depth, summed into price bands either side of the mark price

tools.name: funding
tools.description:
Perp funding rates. With a coin: the rate on each venue (Hyperliquid, Binance,
Bybit, OKX, Bitget, Gate) normalised to 8 hours, plus the open-interest
weighted aggregate. Without: the markets paying the most positive and most
negative funding right now. Positive = longs pay shorts.

tools.name: coin_history
tools.description:
A metric's history for one market (with the price where the data has it),
thinned to at most 60 points.

tools.name: recent_liquidations
tools.description:
Individual Hyperliquid liquidation fills, newest first, straight off the
node: who was liquidated, on which market, how big, at what price. One
liquidation can be several fills sharing an order id.

tools.name: liquidation_totals
tools.description:
How much was liquidated. Without a coin: every market ranked by liquidated
USD over the window, long vs short. With a coin: long and short liquidations
per time bucket. Windows that the node missed are listed under `gaps` -- those
are missing data, not quiet periods.

tools.name: cascades
tools.description:
Past sharp moves (at least `min_move_pct` in one 4-hour step) paired with how
much liquidation exposure sat in their path just before -- the evidence for
whether clusters actually get run.

tools.name: top_positions
tools.description:
The largest open positions on Hyperliquid right now, longs and shorts, read
live from the node: wallet, size, notional, entry, leverage, liquidation price
and how far price is from it, unrealised PnL, and the wallet's size cohort.

tools.name: wallet
tools.description:
One Hyperliquid wallet right now, read live from the node: account value,
PnL, every open position with leverage, liquidation price and how far price is
from it, and its open orders (limits, stops and take-profits).

tools.name: cohort_positioning
tools.description:

size (Micro under $250 up to Whale over $1M) and by all-time PnL (Highly

tools.name: cohort_top_coins
tools.description:
Which coins one trader cohort is most long and most short on, ranked across
every market: "What are the most profitable traders most bullish and most
bearish on?" Each coin has the cohort's long and short notional, net USD,
share long and wallet count, plus the cohort's overall lean across all marke

tools.name: leaderboard
tools.description: Hyperliquid wallets ranked by all-time PnL or by 30-day volume.
